shell: A web app screen with a slim top bar titled "Planning & Review"; under it a left-to-right tab strip with four tabs in this exact order: "Work", "Architecture", "Assurance", "Review". Left of the main area a narrow sidebar titled "Selected" showing one small card labeled "Work unit W-3" with the lines "revision a1b2c3" and "source: weekly plan"; that card is identical in every picture. A thin status bar at the bottom reads "same object, four views".

conditions.text: Every object on the screen reveals more information when clicked; nothing is a dead end.

pictures.label: Work
pictures.instruction: The "Work" tab is active (underlined). Main area: a left-to-right dependency graph of about eight boxes labeled "W-1" through "W-8" connected by arrows; "W-3" is highlighted; two boxes carry a small "blocked" tag, one carries "ready". A small legend: done / active / blocked.

pictures.label: Architecture
pictures.instruction: The "Architecture" tab is active. Main area: a boxes-and-lines system diagram with about six components labeled "Component A" to "Component F" and two labeled contracts between them, "Contract X" and "Contract Y"; the component touched by the selected item W-3 is highlighted, the rest dimmed.

pictures.label: Assurance
pictures.instruction: The "Assurance" tab is active. Main area: a table with rows "Requirement R-1" to "Requirement R-6" and columns "Work", "Test", "Evidence"; cells hold check marks, empty cells, or a small "partial" tag; the row linked to W-3 is highlighted; one row carries an "uncovered" tag.

pictures.label: Review
pictures.instruction: The "Review" tab is active. Main area in two columns: left titled "What changed" with three placeholder bullets and a small "drift" tag on one; right titled "Evidence" with three placeholder rows each with a source link icon. Below both, a box titled "Needs human judgment" with one placeholder line and two buttons, "Accept" and "Request changes".
